en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large rectangular military barracks building fronting an open parade ground. The multi‑storey structure has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance, with young trees lining the street in front. Printed German titles in red identify the location as Dresden and specify that it is the barracks of the 3rd and 4th companies of the 12th Infantry Regiment No. 177. Publisher information is printed along the sides.
